author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಜತನದಲಿ ಕಾಪಾಡು ಸಿಕ್ಕಿರುವ ನರಜನ್ಮ
ಸತ್ತಮೇಲಿನ ಗತಿಯ ಯಾರು ತಿಳಿದಿಹರು
ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಒಯ್ಯುವಿಯೇನು ನಿನ್ನಾಸ್ತಿ ಧನಕನಕ
ಒತ್ತೆಯಿಡು ಸ್ವಾರ್ಥವನೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Guard with care the human birth you have been given;
who knows the way that lies beyond death?
Will you carry with you your property, wealth and gold?
Pawn away your selfishness instead, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A human life is a rare gift; look after it. No one knows what follows death, and no possession goes with us. Better to let go of selfishness while we can.
